text: Steve Teekens, Executive Director, Native Men's Residence, and Vice President, Toronto Aboriginal Support Services Council (TASSC), and Paul Raftis, Interim General Manager, Shelter, Support and Housing Administration (SSHA), City of Toronto, will give a presentation on the Meeting in the Middle Engagement Strategy and Action Plan that was co-developed by SSHA, TASSC, and the Aboriginal Community Advisory Board. The presentation will provide an overview of the process for co-developing the Strategy and Action Plan and the commitments and actions that SSHA and Indigenous partners in the housing and homelessness service sectors have agreed to uphold.
The Aboriginal Affairs Committee received the item for information.
